cases.sentence: ___ Иисуса Христа, данное Ему Богом для того, чтобы показать Своим слугам.
cases.translation: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave to Him.
cases.explain: Откровение is the grammatical subject of the sentence.

cases.sentence: Это Слово ___ и свидетельство Иисуса Христа.
cases.translation: This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
cases.explain: The genitive case indicates possession (word of God).

cases.sentence: Он сообщил это откровение через Своего ___, Своему слуге Иоанну.
cases.translation: He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John.
cases.explain: The preposition через (through) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: От Иоанна, семи церквам в провинции Азия. Благодать и мир вам от того, кто есть, кто был и кто придет, и от семи духов, находящихся у его ___.
cases.translation: From the seven spirits who are before His throne.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at/by) governs the genitive case in Russian.

cases.sentence: Он любит нас, и своей ___ освободил нас от наших грехов.
cases.translation: He loves us and freed us from our sins by His power.
cases.explain: The preposition своей indicates the means, requiring the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Он сделал нас ___ и священниками своего Бога и Отца.
cases.translation: He made us a kingdom and priests to His God and Father.
cases.explain: After the verb сделал with two predicate nominatives, the instrumental case is used.

cases.sentence: И вот он придет с ___, и увидит его всякое око.
cases.translation: Behold, He is coming with the clouds.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Находясь в заключении на ___, называемом Патмос, за слово Божие и за свидетельство об Иисусе.
cases.translation: On the isle that is called Patmos because of the word of God.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with location governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Откровение Иисуса Христа, данное Ему Богом для того, чтобы показать Своим слугам, что должно вскоре произойти.
reading.question: What is the purpose of the Revelation given to Jesus Christ?
options: To show His servants the things that must happen soon
To explain all mysteries of God
reading.correct: To show His servants the things that must happen soon
reading.explain: The text clearly states that the revelation was given чтобы показать (to show) to His servants что должно вскоре произойти (what must happen soon).

reading.ru: Блажен тот, кто читает, и те, кто слушает эти пророческие слова и исполняет их, потому что время уже близко.
reading.question: Who is blessed according to this verse?
options: Those who read and hear the prophetic words and keep them, because the time is near
Those who wait passively for the end
reading.correct: Those who read and hear the prophetic words and keep them, because the time is near
reading.explain: The text declares блажен (blessed) is тот, кто читает и слушает и исполняет (the one who reads and hears and keeps) these words.

reading.ru: Он любит нас, и своей кровью освободил нас от наших грехов.
reading.question: How did Jesus free us from our sins?
reading.explain: The verse explicitly states освободил нас своей кровью (freed us by His blood).

reading.ru: Он сделал нас царством и священниками своего Бога и Отца.
reading.question: What did Jesus make us according to this passage?
options: A kingdom and priests to His God and Father
reading.correct: A kingdom and priests to His God and Father
reading.explain: The text explicitly says Он сделал нас царством и священниками (He made us a kingdom and priests).

reading.ru: И вот он придет с облаками, и увидит его всякое око, включая и тех, которые его пронзили.
reading.question: How will Christ come and who will see Him?
options: He will come with clouds and every eye will see Him, including those who pierced Him
He will come secretly and only believers will see Him
He will appear only in Jerusalem
He will return invisibly to the earth
reading.correct: He will come with clouds and every eye will see Him, including those who pierced Him
reading.explain: The text states он придет с облаками (He will come with clouds) и увидит его всякое око (and every eye will see Him).

reading.ru: Я Иоанн, ваш брат и соучастник в страдании, в царстве и терпении в Иисусе.
reading.question: How does John describe himself in relation to the churches?
options: Your brother and partner in tribulation, kingdom, and perseverance in Jesus
A prophet sent directly by God
An angel from heaven with divine messages
reading.correct: Your brother and partner in tribulation, kingdom, and perseverance in Jesus
reading.explain: John identifies himself as ваш брат и соучастник (your brother and partner) в страдании, царстве и терпении (in tribulation, kingdom, and perseverance).
